thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for billing-metering-service — aggregation service failing to emit daily totals (error rate ~22%). Paging oncall.

maya: seeing a bunch of customers pinging about invoice previews showing 0 usage for yesterday. I spot the dashboard charts dropping to zero at 00:05 UTC.

alex-oncall: picking up. can you paste a sample customer id and a screenshot? i'll check the aggregation logs and ingestion pipeline.

maya: customer: acct_6f9b3c. screenshot: https://redwood-internal/links/bug-snap-185 (private). front-end shows 0 tokens for 2026-03-14 but raw usage logs show normal events.

jordan-billing: this looks like the aggregator job didn't finish for the 00:00-01:00 window. i'm seeing retries in the assembler service: "assemble_window failed: UnhandledKeyError". tailing logs now.

alex-oncall: running runbook step 2: restart assembler tasks for window-shard-03 and trigger a backfill for the missing window.

alex-oncall: ```
# backfill command
kubectl exec -it jobs/agg-backfill -- /bin/bash -lc "python backfill.py --start 2026-03-14T00:00:00Z --end 2026-03-14T02:00:00Z --shard 03"
``` 

incident-bot: action started by alex-oncall: backfill job 6853 queued.

jordan-billing: quick check SQL to show discrepancy: ```
SELECT account_id, sum(tokens) as tokens_raw, sum(tokens_processed) as tokens_agg
FROM usage_raw
LEFT JOIN usage_aggregated USING (account_id, date)
WHERE date = '2026-03-14'
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY tokens_raw - tokens_agg DESC
LIMIT 20;
``` 

jordan-billing: for acct_6f9b3c raw=1,234, tokens_agg=0. confirms gap.

emi-cs: FYI CS is seeing ~12 inbound tickets referencing invoices. Should we send a short customer note now or wait for fix?

alex-oncall: we should post a status page 'investigating' now (customers already see wrong invoices). i'll draft a short blurb. tagging @statuspage-bot to prepare update.

statuspage-bot: suggested public update draft: "We are investigating an issue affecting invoice previews and usage displays for a subset of customers. Some customers may see zero usage for recent windows. Engineers are actively backfilling missing aggregations. We will provide updates within 60 minutes." Approve? :thinking:

emi-cs: edit suggestion: add impacted scope line: "Impacted: subset of customers in the hosted API (usage/preview only). Billing charges are not confirmed impacted at this time." Also include recommended customer action: "No action required; we'll notify when data is restored." 

maya: +1 on CS wording. add contact link to support form. keeps noise lower.

alex-oncall: posted to status page as 'investigating' with the suggested text. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1854321789

incident-bot: backfill job 6853 started, progress: 0% -> 18% -> 67%.

jordan-billing: noticing root cause: a schema change from a maintenance deploy yesterday introduced a nullable key on window_id which caused assembler's grouping to skip shards when key=null. PR #4123 reverted earlier this morning but one of the shards still had the older image due to a race in the deploy orchestrator.

alex-oncall: mitigation path: 1) force redeploy assembler image on all shards 2) run backfill for missing windows 3) run reconciliation job comparing raw vs aggregated and produce reconciliation report.

maya: what's ETA on redeploy and backfill? we need to tell customers.

alex-oncall: redeploy going now across 6 shards; expected 5-8 minutes. backfill will run after deploy finishes; estimate 25-40 minutes for the affected day. I'll post timeline once deploy completes.

incident-bot: redeploy completed on shards 01-04. shard-05 failed to pick up image, retrying.

jordan-billing: manual image pull on shard-05 done, assembler restarted, logs show backfill executor picked up window 00:00-02:00 and is processing.

emi-cs: drafting customer notification for affected accounts to be sent after we have a remediation ETA. Draft below — please take.

emi-cs: "Hi — We’re writing to let you know we’re investigating an issue that caused invoice previews and usage displays to temporarily show zero usage for some accounts on 2026-03-14. Our engineering team is backfilling the missing aggregation windows and we expect display values to be restored within 30–45 minutes. No billing charges have been finalized during this period; if anything changes we will notify you. We apologize for the disruption and will follow up when data is fully restored. For urgent questions, please contact support@redwood.ai." 

alex-oncall: looks good. change "we expect" -> "we expect to restore display values within" and add: "If you see discrepancies after restoration, please reply to this message and we'll open a billing review."

emi-cs: updated and queued to send after reconciliation completes. CS will proactively reply to existing tickets pointing to the status page.

incident-bot: backfill job 6853 progress: 67% -> 100%. reconciliation job started (job 6860).

jordan-billing: reconciliation shows ~98% of accounts reconciled automatically. about 18 accounts with complex multi-shard writes need manual investigation (small customers + 2 enterprise accounts). I'll create a reconciliation ticket list and attach to the incident.

alex-oncall: can we prioritize the two enterprise accounts for SLA reasons?

jordan-billing: yes — adding high priority tag and will reach out to account owners. manual fix estimated 2 hours for those two because of cross-day merges.

statuspage-bot: update: "Mitigation in progress — aggregation window backfill completed for the majority of affected accounts. A small number of accounts require manual reconciliation. We expect full restoration for most customers within 45 minutes; two enterprise accounts may require additional manual work and will be handled with priority." Posted at 00:56 UTC.

emi-cs: sending the customer note to affected customers (non-enterprise) now with the earlier draft. enterprise accounts: CS will coordinate bespoke messages after Jordan finishes manual reconciliation plan.

maya: quick note for post-incident: add a runbook item to ensure orchestrator waits for image confirmation across all shards before marking deploy success. that should have prevented the drift.

alex-oncall: agreed — filing infra ticket and adding to next sprint.

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. No live customer charge discrepancies reported so far. tagging next oncall for follow-up in 4 hours.

alex-oncall: handing off to night shift @jordan-billing for reconciliation follow-up and customer outreach. I'll add summary and steps in the incident ticket.

jordan-billing: taking handoff. summary in ticket: root cause = partial deploy leading to null window_id skip; mitigation = redeploy + backfill; outstanding = 18 accounts, 2 enterprise require manual merge. owner = jordan-billing. ETA for full closure = +2h for enterprise fixes, +30m for majority.

emi-cs: copied final customer message: "We have restored usage displays for most customers. Two enterprise accounts have been flagged for manual reconciliation; their account owners will receive a follow-up within 2 hours. If you still see incorrect values, please reply here or open a support ticket." Will send once Jordan confirms.

maya: postmortem notes for later: timeline, root cause (schema change + partial deploy), mitigation steps, customer comms timeline, and the suggested deploy gate to avoid shard drift.

incident-bot: incident ticket updated and set to incident-outreach-required. React when ready. :white_check_mark:
